findings.finding: Worker startup is neither isolated from Python startup injection nor attested as actually sandboxed before capability consumption.
findings.action: Use an isolated minimal bootstrap, environment allowlist and a non-forgeable parent-to-worker sandbox launch proof before importing the runner body.

findings.finding: Success reconciliation accepts invalid or conflicting final directories and permits terminal-state reversal.
findings.action: Validate the complete success bundle and claim binding, reject dual terminals and enforce irreversible terminal transitions.

findings.finding: Failure recovery can downgrade authenticated nonzero sensitive counters to stale event values.
findings.action: Authenticate receipt identity separately and merge counters monotonically across durable evidence.

findings.finding: Success validation does not bind the exact top-level evidence set, qualification semantics, authorization or published event frame.
findings.action: Freeze and verify the exact bundle schema and bind all top-level evidence to both workers, claim and authorization.

findings.finding: Same-direction correlation conflates a genuine zero with unavailable correlation history.
findings.action: Track active and valid-correlation counts and fail closed when active positions exist without a computable correlation.
